🚨INTEL
========
💡Advertises their service on underground forums
💡Unlike other groups, Helix does not target Government Entities
💡Targets US and Canada (as of now)
💡Earliest victim leaks were hosted with a dedicated Onion Domain
💡Later, rest of the victim's leak are shared via GoFile Platform
💡Structured Leak followed (from Sample to Critical): T1 Housekeeping -> T2 Correspondence -> T3 Diligence -> T4 Safekeeping
💡Each files are protected using randomly generated 24-character passwords
💡The Server Response passed through Waitress, a pure-Python WSGI HTTP server
💡Earliest leak traced to 26th July 2026, though the operations might have commenced much earlier
💡Unique TOX IDs are generated for each victim, which is obtained from victim's ransom note
